visualCharacteristics.purpose: Top banner with a text column (eyebrow, heading, description, CTAs) beside a foreground device image, over an optional full-bleed background image
visualCharacteristics.layout: two columns on desktop (text left, image right), stacked on mobile

contentPattern.structure: row 1 (optional): background image only; row 2: eyebrow paragraph, heading, description, CTA link(s), plus an optional side image in the same cell or a second cell
rows: Eyebrow paragraph, heading, description, CTA link(s)

usage: Homepage hero and the subscription banner on https://www.euronpro.com.
reuseGuidance: Use for any banner with text on one side and a product/device image on the other. A single CTA or missing background image are supported without a new variant.
